gravy: She poured hot gravy over the mashed potatoes and passed them around the table.
她把热肉汁浇在土豆泥上,然后分给了桌边的每个人。
prepare for: We need at least a week to prepare for the final exams.
我们至少需要一周时间为期末考试做准备。
another time: I'm busy today, but let's meet for coffee another time.
我今天很忙,但我们改天再一起喝咖啡吧。
hang out: The students like to hang out at the library after class.
学生们喜欢课后泡在图书馆里。
the day before yesterday: The day before yesterday, we visited the museum and took many photos.
前天我们参观了博物馆,拍了很多照片。
the day after tomorrow: The day after tomorrow, my cousin will arrive from the countryside.
后天我的表弟将从乡下过来。
look after: Can you look after my cat while I'm away on business?
我出差期间,你能帮我照看一下我的猫吗?
turn down: Please turn down the music; the baby is sleeping in the next room.
请把音乐调小一点,宝宝正在隔壁睡觉。
goodbye: She waved goodbye to her friends and got on the school bus.
她向朋友们挥手告别,然后上了校车。
surprised: I was surprised to see my old classmate standing at the front door.
看到老同学站在前门口,我感到很惊讶。
look forward to: We all look forward to the summer holidays every year.
我们每年都盼望着暑假的到来。
hear from: Did you hear from your brother after he moved to the new city?
你弟弟搬去那座新城市之后,你有他的消息吗?
housewarming: They invited all their neighbors to a housewarming party last Saturday evening.
上周六晚上,他们邀请了所有邻居来参加乔迁宴。
daytime: Most shops in this street only open during the daytime.
这条街上大多数商店只在白天营业。
potato chips: He ate a whole bag of potato chips while watching the football game.
他一边看足球比赛,一边吃完了一整袋薯片。
keep…to oneself: She decided to keep her worries to herself and told nobody about them.
她决定把烦恼藏在心里,谁也没有告诉。
in half: He took a knife and cut the big apple in half.
他拿刀把大苹果切成了两半。
fall in love with: She fell in love with the small town at first sight.
她对这座小镇一见倾心。
pal: My old pal from school is coming to visit me next week.
我学生时代的老朋友下周要来看我。
connect … with: This road connects our village with the nearest town.
这条路把我们的村子与最近的城镇连接起来。
wisely: Think carefully and choose wisely when you make such an important decision.
做如此重要的决定时,要认真思考,明智地选择。
Annie: Annie spent the whole afternoon teaching her little brother to ride a bike.
安妮花了整个下午教她弟弟骑自行车。
Alexander Graham Bell: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in the nineteenth century.
亚历山大•格雷厄姆•贝尔在十九世纪发明了电话。
put on: He put on a lot of weight after eating fast food every day.
他每天吃快餐,体重增加了很多。
goddess: In the old story, a kind goddess helped the poor fisherman again and again.
在古老的故事里,善良的女神一次又一次地帮助贫穷的渔夫。
lay out: Mom will lay out the dishes and chopsticks before dinner starts.
晚饭开始前,妈妈会摆好碗筷。
haunted: Nobody wants to live in that old haunted house on the hill.
没人想住在山上那座闹鬼的老房子里。
Macao: Macao is famous for its delicious food and old streets.
澳门以美食和古老的街道而闻名。
Chiang Mai: Chiang Mai attracts many tourists with its beautiful temples and night markets.
清迈以美丽的寺庙和夜市吸引了许多游客。
Halloween: Children wear funny costumes and ask for candy on Halloween.
万圣节前夕,孩子们穿着有趣的服装去要糖果。
Valentine’s Day: On Valentine’s Day, many young couples give each other cards and flowers.
情人节这天,许多年轻情侣互赠贺卡和鲜花。
Clara: Clara keeps a small diary and writes in it every evening.
克拉拉有一本小日记本,每天晚上都写几句。
Santa: The children wrote letters to Santa before Christmas.
孩子们在圣诞节前给圣诞老人写了信。
Charles Dickens: Charles Dickens wrote many famous novels about poor people in London.
查尔斯•狄更斯写了许多关于伦敦穷人的著名小说。
Scrooge: In the story, Scrooge learned to be kind and generous again.
在故事中,斯克鲁奇重新学会了善良和慷慨。
Jacob Marley: Jacob Marley was Scrooge's dead business partner in the famous novel.
在这部著名小说里,雅各布•马利是斯克鲁奇已故的生意伙伴。
washroom: Excuse me, could you tell me where the washroom is?
打扰一下,您能告诉我洗手间在哪儿吗?
faithfully: The old dog waited faithfully by the door until his owner returned.
那只老狗忠实地守在门边,直到主人回来。
Kevin: Kevin practices the guitar for an hour every day after school.
凯文每天放学后练习一小时吉他。
Tim: Tim is always ready to help his classmates with their homework.
蒂姆总是乐于帮助同学们做作业。
